description: Whether the editor addon is connected, which Godot answers, whether the editor is playing something, and which games with the runtime addon are reachable, of this project and of every other on the machine. Read connected with mayYetConnect: the editor dials this server and backs off between tries, so for the first half-minute after a server starts false means not reached yet as often as no editor; mayYetConnect true is worth waiting out, false is final, and editorCannotConnect, restartInterrupted, restartUnderway, closedHere and editorsNotYetConnected say why. An editor that has connected and not yet greeted reports nothing about itself, and every other call made in that window waits up to ten seconds for it to settle. playingInEditor null means unanswered rather than nothing playing: processActive and runtimes do not depend on the editor answering. game.run names the run editor_output and editor_run stop answer for, and stays named after it ends. addonIsStale, on a connected editor and on each running game (absent with neither), says it runs addon code other than what this server ships, and staleNote says which half moves: the project, by a gdharness upgrade it spells out to run in a shell, the editor by a restart, or this server by a reconnect. A false editor.lspListening or editor.dapListening comes with serversNote, and editor_launch restart binds the port again. editor.scan says whether the editor is scanning, which editor_run waits out before starting a game. A game announced in a protocol this server does not speak is listed under unreadable, during an upgrade that moves the protocol, until the halves match. The tool reference in the gdharness skill, and the site, say what every field of the answer means.
name: editor_status
title: Editor status
